SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_setup_plan p JOIN arch_environment env ON env.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND env.id=p.environment_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND p.status=#{status} AND p.plan_owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.plan_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM arch_plan_target pt WHERE pt.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND pt.plan_id=p.id AND pt.target_type=#{targetType} AND pt.target_id=#{targetId} AND pt.status='ACTIVE')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_plan_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND plan_id=#{planId} AND cancelled=0 AND status <> 'COMPLETED' AND planned_end IS NOT NULL AND planned_end < #{now}

SELECT p.id,p.plan_no,p.name,p.environment_id,p.status,p.template_id,p.template_version_no,p.plan_owner_user_id,p.planned_start,p.planned_end,p.actual_start,p.actual_end,p.cancelled,p.cancel_reason,p.cancelled_by,p.cancelled_at,p.row_version,env.code AS environment_code,env.name AS environment_name,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_plan_task t WHERE t.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND t.plan_id=p.id AND t.cancelled=0) AS task_count,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_plan_check_item ci JOIN arch_plan_task ct ON ct.tenant_id=ci.tenant_id AND ct.id=ci.task_id WHERE ci.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND ct.plan_id=p.id AND ct.cancelled=0 AND ci.cancelled=0) AS total_check_items,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_plan_check_item ci JOIN arch_plan_task ct ON ct.tenant_id=ci.tenant_id AND ct.id=ci.task_id WHERE ci.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND ct.plan_id=p.id AND ct.cancelled=0 AND ci.cancelled=0 AND ci.status='COMPLETED') AS completed_check_items,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_plan_check_item ci JOIN arch_plan_task ct ON ct.tenant_id=ci.tenant_id AND ct.id=ci.task_id WHERE ci.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND ct.plan_id=p.id AND ct.cancelled=0 AND ci.cancelled=1) AS cancelled_check_items,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM arch_plan_block b JOIN arch_plan_task bt ON bt.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND bt.id=b.task_id WHERE b.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND bt.plan_id=p.id AND b.status='OPEN' AND bt.cancelled=0) AS open_blocks FROM arch_setup_plan p JOIN arch_environment env ON env.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND env.id=p.environment_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND p.environment_id=#{environmentId} AND p.status=#{status} AND p.plan_owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND (p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.plan_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM arch_plan_target pt WHERE pt.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND pt.plan_id=p.id AND pt.target_type=#{targetType} AND pt.target_id=#{targetId} AND pt.status='ACTIVE') ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
